note: Sequence of events a normal run must emit, in order. Used by tools/integration.ps1 against the real sandbox watcher and, later, against the C# watcher. 'data' is compared exactly unless 'dataMode' is 'prefix' (then the value must start with it, e.g. 'version=' or 'pid='). Events not listed here (auto-update.start, insurance.*, guard.* for a healthy run) are allowed but not required, except 'forbid' which must never appear in a clean run.
